keyClauses.name: Definition of Confidential Information
keyClauses.whatToCheck: Is it broadly or narrowly defined? What is excluded?

keyClauses.name: Duration of Obligation
keyClauses.whatToCheck: How long must the information be kept secret? Is it forever?

keyClauses.name: Permitted Use
keyClauses.whatToCheck: What are you allowed to do with the information?

keyClauses.name: Exceptions
keyClauses.whatToCheck: Is there a carve-out for information already public or legally requested?

keyClauses.name: Remedies
keyClauses.whatToCheck: What happens if a breach occurs? Are injunctions mentioned?
